description: Run deterministic stage-1 ECM on a supplied nonsingular Montgomery curve and point; report whether any checkpoint exposes a proper factor.

source.title: Factorize (Large), in-progress Library Checker proposal #1395; Lenstra ECM
source.license: Library Checker repository Apache-2.0; algorithm descriptions only; clean-room implementation
source.implementation_status: bounded deterministic stage-1 profile; not a complete factorizer

input.point_range: 0<=X,Y<N and Y^2 congruent to X^3+A*X^2+X modulo N

output.meaning: 1 if a stage-1 checkpoint has 1<gcd(Z,N)<N; a gcd equal to N terminates the curve with 0 because the point is infinity modulo every prime factor; otherwise 0

workspace.meaning: Fixed scalar state for Montgomery ladder coordinates, small-prime schedule, and validation.

complexity.primary_time: O(sqrt(N)) bounded domain validation plus O(sum(log(q^floor(log_q B1)))) Montgomery ladder steps for primes q<=B1

oracle_method: The primary uses Montgomery X:Z differential addition and a binary ladder for each maximal prime-power scalar. The independent oracle trial-factors the square-free bounded N and applies affine elliptic-curve group addition separately over each prime field.
